## NTF 04 - Content Repurposing

**Trigger:** Webhook, POST with `{ url: "https://your-blog-post" }`

**Flow:**
1. Receive URL via webhook
2. Extract full article text via Jina.ai Reader (free)
3. Claude generates LinkedIn post, newsletter section, tweet thread
4. All three drafts written to a Google Doc
5. Slack notification with the doc link

**Setup:**
- No Jina.ai API key needed (uses public reader endpoint)
- Connect Google Docs OAuth credential
- Set your Google Drive folder ID for output docs
- Edit the Claude prompt voice/tone instructions to match your brand
- Set your Slack channel ID

parameters.text:
=You are a professional content strategist. Repurpose the article below into three formats.

VOICE INSTRUCTIONS: Direct, professional, no buzzwords, plain English. First person. No em dashes.

Return a JSON object with these keys:
- linkedin_post: A LinkedIn post (150-250 words). Hook first line, 3-5 bullet points or short paragraphs, CTA question at end, 5 hashtags at bottom.
- newsletter_section: A newsletter section (200-300 words). Subheading, intro paragraph, 2-3 key points, link back to the original article.
- tweet_thread: A tweet thread of 5-7 tweets. Number each tweet (1/, 2/, etc.). First tweet is the hook. Last tweet links to article.

Article:
{{ $('Fetch Article via Jina.ai').item.json.data }}

Return only valid JSON. No markdown fencing.
